questions.question: A colleague rolls their eyes while someone presents an idea. Which horseman is this?
questions.answer: Contempt. It is the most serious of the four.

questions.question: What do you do instead of criticism?
questions.answer: Raise your concern gently, with an "I" statement. Talk about a specific behaviour, not the person.

questions.question: What do you do instead of defensiveness?
questions.answer: Listen carefully, accept your share of responsibility and apologise.

questions.question: What do you do instead of contempt?
questions.answer: Recognise the other person's qualities and state your own needs. A word of appreciation can be enough.

questions.question: How is a time-out different from stonewalling?
questions.answer: Stonewalling is withdrawing without a word, so the other person feels ignored. In a time-out you say you need a few minutes to think, then you come back to the conversation.
